vulnerabilities.title: No Rate Limiting on Login Bypass Endpoint (cmd=1000)
vulnerabilities.description: The cmd=1000 (WechatLogin bypass) endpoint accepts unlimited rapid requests without any rate limiting. 10 concurrent requests all returned valid sids with different session tokens.
vulnerabilities.evidence: 10 rapid POST requests to /boxApi.php?cmd=1000 all returned status=0 with unique sids
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement rate limiting (e.g., 5 attempts per IP per minute), CAPTCHA after threshold

vulnerabilities.title: Undocumented API Endpoints Exposing PII and Financial Data
vulnerabilities.description: 14 additional API endpoints discovered beyond the 12 in the phishing script, including cmd=290 (truename/real name PII), cmd=520/530 (trading history), cmd=810 (lottery/VIP rewards list)
vulnerabilities.evidence: Full cmd enumeration from 100-990 (step 10) with fresh sid
vulnerabilities.remediation: API gateway with proper access control; audit cmd routing for least privilege

vulnerabilities.title: Password Management Endpoints Exposed
vulnerabilities.description: cmd=100 requires password, cmd=120 enforces password length 6-12 chars — password change functionality directly exposed via API
vulnerabilities.evidence: cmd=100 returned '請填寫密碼' (Please fill in password), cmd=120 returned '密碼必須在6-12個字符內' (Password must be 6-12 chars)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add additional authentication factor for password changes

vulnerabilities.title: Redemption Code Enumeration Endpoint
vulnerabilities.description: cmd=270 exposes redemption code validation — can enumerate valid gift card/redemption codes
vulnerabilities.evidence: cmd=270 returned '無此兌換碼' (No such redemption code) for invalid codes
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add rate limiting and account lockout for redemption code attempts

vulnerabilities.title: Information Leakage via Generic Error Messages
vulnerabilities.description: API returns detailed error messages for different cmd values, revealing internal system structure
vulnerabilities.evidence: Various status codes (-98, -1010, -1011, -1013, -2007, -2509, -2601, -5499, -1499, -1160) with descriptive messages
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use generic error messages, log detailed errors server-side only
